WITH projects AS ( SELECT p.PROJ_ID, p.PROJ_NM, p.CTRT_BGN_DT, p.CTRT_END_DT FROM TB_PJ_PROJ p WHERE p.CTRT_BGN_DT <= make_date(#{year},12,31) AND p.CTRT_END_DT >= make_date(#{year},1,1) AND p.PROJ_ID=#{projectId} ), plans AS ( SELECT m.PROJ_ID, m.JOB_CD, SUM(m.PLAN_MM) AS mm FROM TB_PJ_MNPW_PLAN m JOIN projects p ON p.PROJ_ID=m.PROJ_ID GROUP BY m.PROJ_ID, m.JOB_CD HAVING SUM(m.PLAN_MM) > 0 ), actual AS ( SELECT a.PROJ_ID, a.JOB_CD, SUM(m.MON_MM) AS mm FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a JOIN projects p ON p.PROJ_ID=a.PROJ_ID JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN_MON m ON m.ASGN_ID=a.ASGN_ID WHERE a.ASGN_STAT_CD!='CNCL' AND m.INPUT_YM BETWEEN (CAST(#{year} AS text)||'01') AND (CAST(#{year} AS text)||'12') GROUP BY a.PROJ_ID, a.JOB_CD HAVING SUM(m.MON_MM) > 0 ), jobs AS (
SELECT p.PROJ_ID, p.JOB_CD FROM plans p UNION SELECT a.PROJ_ID, a.JOB_CD FROM actual a ) SELECT p.PROJ_ID AS "projectId", p.PROJ_NM AS "projectName", j.JOB_CD AS "jobCode", COALESCE(c.CODE_NM,j.JOB_CD) AS "jobName", p.CTRT_BGN_DT AS "startDate", p.CTRT_END_DT AS "endDate", COALESCE(n.mm,0) AS "plannedMm", COALESCE(a.mm,0) AS "actualMm" FROM jobs j JOIN projects p ON p.PROJ_ID=j.PROJ_ID LEFT JOIN plans n ON n.PROJ_ID=j.PROJ_ID AND n.JOB_CD=j.JOB_CD LEFT JOIN actual a ON a.PROJ_ID=j.PROJ_ID AND a.JOB_CD=j.JOB_CD LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE c ON c.CODE_GRP_ID='JOB' AND c.CODE=j.JOB_CD WHERE TRUE ORDER BY p.PROJ_ID, j.JOB_CD
